text: ① 全天 中国内地、中国台湾、韩国金融市场因中秋节休市； ② 17:15 美国纽约联储主席（享有FOMC永久投票权，号称美联储三把手）威廉姆斯在一个政策研讨会讲话，英国央行行长贝利讲话； ③ 全天 习近平对美国进行国事访问（9月23-25日）； ④ 20:30 美国8月耐用品订单初值； ⑤ 21:20 美国堪萨斯城联储主席Jeff Schmid参加一场炉边闲聊； ⑥ 22:00 美国9月密歇根大学消费者信心指数终值； ⑦ 次日02:00 美国克利夫兰联储主席Hammack在一场关于通胀的会议上参加讨论，欧洲央行副主席Boris Vujcic也在克利夫兰联
text_en: ① All day: Financial markets in mainland China, Taiwan, and South Korea are closed for the Mid-Autumn Festival; ② 17:15: New York Fed President Williams, who holds a permanent vote on the FOMC and is known as the Fed's third-ranking official, speaks at a policy seminar, and BOE Governor Bailey speaks; ③ All day: Xi Jinping makes a state visit to the United States (September 23-25); ④ 20:30: U.S. August durable goods orders preliminary reading; ⑤ 21:20: Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid participates in a fireside chat; ⑥ 22:00: Final reading of the University of Michigan U.S. September consumer sentiment index; ⑦ 02:00 the next day: Cleveland Fed President Hammack participates in a discussion at a conference on inflation, and ECB Vice President Boris Vujcic is also at the Cleveland Fed
